```{r}
# Clean environment

# load libraries
library(stringr)

# Import tree

# Load metadata SCs
```

# recombination-free full tree
```{r}
# Load recombination-free tree
Gubbins_tree <- read.tree("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Gubbins/Fulltree/gubbins_fulltree_nostarttree.final_tree.tre")
Gubbins_tree_mid <- midpoint.root(Gubbins_tree)


# Load metadata
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)

# Load phenotypes
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
phenotypes <- read.table("phenotypes.txt", header=T)
phenotypes <- phenotypes |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(continuous<=7, "EOD", 
                          ifelse(continuous<=89, "LOD", "VLOD")))

# Prep metadata for tree
fewer5_SC <- which(table(SCs$SC)<=7)
metadata_tree <- SCs |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:12, "other")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% Gubbins_tree_mid$tip.label)

# Join metadata and tree 
Gubbins_tree_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Gubbins_tree_mid, metadata_tree$label), metadata_tree , by = 'label')
Gubbins_tree_mid_Nsub  <- Gubbins_tree_mid
Gubbins_tree_mid_Nsub$edge.length  <- Gubbins_tree_mid$edge.length/2231314
Gubbins_tree_mid_metadata_Nsub  <- full_join(keep.tip(Gubbins_tree_mid_Nsub, metadata_tree$label), metadata_tree , by = 'label')

# Prepare colors for phylo
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd","#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#f7b6d2",  "black")
names(SC_colors) <- c(1:12, "other")

# SC tips
# Scale: Number of substitutions 
Gubbins_tree_p1 <- ggtree(Gubbins_tree_mid_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)+ 
  geom_treescale(x=0, y=1400, width=2000, color='red', fontsize=6, linesize=2, offset=20)
Gubbins_tree_p1

# Scale: Rate of substitutions / Site
Gubbins_tree_p1_Nsub <- ggtree(Gubbins_tree_mid_metadata_Nsub, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)+ 
  geom_treescale(x=0, y=1400, width=round(2000/2231314,5), color='red', fontsize=6, linesize=2, offset=20)
Gubbins_tree_p1_Nsub
```

# Plot distribution of Recombination block and regions, highlighting accessory regions and the cps locus
```{r}
# Load Branch statistics
recomb_predictions <- read.gff("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Gubbins/Fulltree/gubbins_fulltree_nostarttree.recombination_predictions.gff", na.strings = c(".", "?"), GFF3 = TRUE)
  
# Get accessory regions from Missingness proportion 
Missingness_Prop <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/Missingness_Prop.txt")
Accesory_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop |> filter(V2>=0.05) |> pull(V1)
Core_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop |> filter(V2<0.05) |> pull(V1)

# Get cps locus
cps_POS <- 1205397:1207538 


# merge consecutive positions into ranges
get_ranges <- function(pos) {
  if (length(pos) == 0) return(data.frame(start=integer(), end=integer()))
  pos <- sort(pos)
  split <- c(0, cumsum(diff(pos) != 1))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pos, split), function(x) data.frame(start=min(x), end=max(x))))
}

# Preparing shading data
accessory_df <- get_ranges(Accesory_region_POS)
cps_df <- get_ranges(cps_POS)
accessory_df$region_type <- "Accessory region"
cps_df$region_type <- "cps locus"
shaded_regions <- bind_rows(accessory_df, cps_df)
shaded_regions <- shaded_regions %>%
  mutate(alpha = ifelse(region_type == "Accessory region", 0.2, 1))

# Plot Recombination blocks
p_recomb_block <- recomb_predictions %>%
  mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = mid), bins = 500, 
                 fill = "grey80", color = "black") +
  geom_rect(
    data = shaded_regions,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = region_type, alpha = alpha),
    color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Region", 
    values = c("Accessory region" = "red", "cps locus" = "blue")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +  # use the alpha values directly
  theme_classic()
p_recomb_block

# Plot The number of Recombination blocks spanning each genomic position
deconvoluted_df <- recomb_predictions %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(position = list(seq(start, end))) %>%   # List of positions for each row
  unnest(position) %>%
  ungroup()

p_recomb_pos <- deconvoluted_df %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = position), bins = 500, 
                 fill = "grey80", color = "black") +
  geom_rect(
    data = shaded_regions,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = region_type, alpha = alpha),
    color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Region", 
    values = c("Accessory region" = "red", "cps locus" = "blue")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +  # use the alpha values directly
  theme_classic()
p_recomb_pos
```

# Investigate the large peak or recombination 
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Compute the midpoint for each interval
recomb_predictions <- recomb_predictions %>%
  mutate(mid = (start + end) / 2)

# Step 2: Define the bin breaks
bin_breaks <- seq(min(recomb_predictions$mid), 
                  max(recomb_predictions$mid), 
                  length.out = 501) # 500 bins means 501 breaks

# Step 3: Assign each 'mid' value to a bin
# The labels = FALSE option makes bin value an integer for grouping
recomb_binned_table <- recomb_predictions %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(mid, breaks = bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    bin_start = bin_breaks[unique(bin)],
    bin_end = bin_breaks[unique(bin)+1]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Preview result
print(recomb_binned_table, n = 10)

recomb_binned_table |> filter(count >150)

# Check which recombination block is driving the peak
peak_recomb <- recomb_predictions |> 
  filter(start %in% 847574:852027 | end %in% 847574:852027)|> 
  mutate(range= paste0(start, "-", end))
table(peak_recomb$range)

min(Missingness_Prop |>  filter(V2>=0.05) |> filter(V1 > 848719 ) |>  pull(V1))

## Prepare heatmap data for phylo: CC
```

# Get rates of recombination across genome, comparing accessory, core and cps locus
```{r}
# Rate in accessory regions
Accesory_deconvoluted_df <- deconvoluted_df |>  filter(position %in% Accesory_region_POS) 
r_acc <- nrow(Accesory_deconvoluted_df)/length(Accesory_region_POS)
# on average, around 34.0 recombination blocks span each genomic position in accessory regions. 

# Rate in Core regions
Core_deconvoluted_df <- deconvoluted_df |>  filter(position %in% Core_region_POS) 
r_core <- nrow(Core_deconvoluted_df)/length(Core_region_POS)
# on average, around 8.4 recombination blocks span each genomic position in accessory regions. 

# Rate in cps locus
cps_deconvoluted_df <- deconvoluted_df |>  filter(position %in% cps_POS) 
r_cps <- nrow(cps_deconvoluted_df)/length(cps_POS)
# on average, around 34.8 recombination blocks span each genomic position in accessory regions. 
```

```{r}
SC10_branch_stats <-  read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Gubbins/SC10/gubbins_SC10_out.per_branch_statistics.csv")

# Overall  r.m 
# r.m = Number.of.SNPs.Inside.Recombinations/Number.of.SNPs.Outside.Recombination
r.m_calc <- function(data){
  round(sum(data$Number.of.SNPs.Inside.Recombinations)/sum(data$Number.of.SNPs.Outside.Recombination), 2)
}
Fulltree_r.m <- r.m_calc(Fulltree_branch_stats)
SC1_r.m <- r.m_calc(SC1_branch_stats)
SC2_r.m <- r.m_calc(SC2_branch_stats)
SC3_r.m <- r.m_calc(SC3_branch_stats)

SC6_r.m <- r.m_calc(SC6_branch_stats)
SC7_r.m <- r.m_calc(SC7_branch_stats)
SC8_r.m <-  r.m_calc(SC8_branch_stats)
SC9_r.m <-  r.m_calc(SC9_branch_stats)
SC10_r.m <- r.m_calc(SC10_branch_stats)

# Overall  rho.theta 
# rho.theta = Number.of.Recombination.Blocks/Number.of.SNPs.Outside.Recombination
rho.theta_calc <- function(data){
  round(sum(data$Number.of.Recombination.Blocks)/sum(data$Number.of.SNPs.Outside.Recombination), 2)
}
Fulltree_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(Fulltree_branch_stats)
SC1_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC1_branch_stats)
SC2_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC2_branch_stats)
SC3_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC3_branch_stats)
SC4_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC4_branch_stats)
SC5_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC5_branch_stats)
SC6_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC6_branch_stats)
SC7_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC7_branch_stats)
SC8_rho.theta <-  rho.theta_calc(SC8_branch_stats)
SC9_rho.theta <-  rho.theta_calc(SC9_branch_stats)
SC10_rho.theta <- rho.theta_calc(SC10_branch_stats)

# Put results together
df_r.m_rho.theta <- data.frame(SC = c("Fulltree", paste0("SC", 1:10)), 
           r.m = c(Fulltree_r.m, SC1_r.m,SC2_r.m,SC3_r.m,SC4_r.m,SC5_r.m,SC6_r.m,SC7_r.m,SC8_r.m,SC9_r.m,SC10_r.m), 
           rho.theta = c(Fulltree_rho.theta,SC1_rho.theta,SC2_rho.theta,SC3_rho.theta,SC4_rho.theta,SC5_rho.theta,SC6_rho.theta,SC7_rho.theta,SC8_rho.theta,SC9_rho.theta,SC10_rho.theta))
df_r.m_rho.theta
```
